result.summary: The team agreed on a temporary timeout increase today to unblock Friday month-end exports, with a permanent background-job fix shipping Tuesday. Mei will validate the stopgap tomorrow morning, and Elena will deliver an incident summary and service-credit answer by Thursday. Tom will add export-timeout monitoring and write a post-mortem by next Wednesday.
